content.text: All eight preferred elements are present in §§ 22.1–22.2, and § 23 contains no additional Vendor inspection right.

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 meets the preferred AUDIT position in full: audits are capped at once in any twelve-month period, require thirty days' prior written notice, occur during normal business hours, are conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1), and Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent, with Vendor and its auditor expressly barred from accessing Customer systems directly (22.2). Section 22.3 further protects us by making findings Customer Confidential Information. The only other records-related heading (§ 23) contains no operative Vendor inspection or verification right binding Customer, so there is no unlimited or remote-access audit route elsewhere. No redline required.
